svg.aria-label: A messy kitchen seen from above: a cook's path loops from the stove to a far-off spice rack, back to the sink, across the room to a drawer and back again. Next to it the developer's version: from the editor out to Slack for a credential, to a browser dashboard, to an SSH session, through nine windows for a log, and back to the editor each time. Every loop is a walk.
svg.text: every trip is short. that's why nobody fixes it
five trips to cook one dish
and back to the editor, every time
the clock isn't the cost. the thought you were holding is.
